description: Measured by the OptionParser session: per-literal keying of returned arguments costs about +6.5% compile work per additional distinct call of the same function. Evidence path to be added by that session. Concordant with fz-y6w (accumulator fanout) and fz-sc8.127 (a protocol callback's non-receiver arguments are keyed only where an implementation returns them): check whether one rule covers all three before building.
title: A returned argument is keyed by its type, not by each literal
